mu_name_from: MuMain loads MU's Thunder Hawk as the fourth MODEL_DARK_PHOENIX_* slot from Data/Player/BootMale21.bmd (ZzzOpenData.cpp:170-198: file 18 + i, i = 3; no helm, i < 3 only). MU's number 20. Ours is *Male21 by the index-plus-one rule.
why_this_one: The missing-gear audit, 2026-10-22: the Magic Gladiator's set that fills drop levels 88-107 (the user: 'start with Thunder Hawk, since it fills the gap at drop levels 88-107').

stats.note: The item's own row: OpenMU's Season 6 initialiser (0.75 and 0.95d have none).
stats.walk_speed_note: OpenMU's walkSpeed 2, as its row has it.
stats.class_level_note: The Magic Gladiator's: OpenMU's magicGladiatorClassLevel 1, his only class. No helm: MU loads none for this slot.

sheet_from: MuMain/src/bin/Data/Player {upper,lower,gloves,boots}_15.OZT, decoded with pipeline/decode_texture.py and prefixed thunderhawk_: dark violet plate striped in pink with gold rivets. hide is MU's black 2x2 sheet, drawn as it is.
cutout_from: Declared, not detected: the .OZT's alpha is real (decode_texture: upper 11%, lower 17%, gloves 6%, boots 6% cut away) and the UVs cover it -- the pink-edged slits through the plate.
cutout_alpha_from: The sheet's own alpha, not its brightness: this violet is dark, and a brightness key would cut the paint away (Divine's trap, 2026-10-04).
material_note: plate_steel, as Destroy: Thunder Hawk's paint reflects as coloured steel rather than lacquer (the user, 2026-10-23: 'i think MG metal could be more metaalic no?', then all three of his lacquered sets).
effects_note: MuMain has no render arm for Thunder Hawk (no glow, no chrome pass). Its full-set bonus is not given: sim::setDefense counts only Storm Crow and Hurricane for the Magic Gladiator.
